mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.student_no, s.student_name, IFNULL(SUM(c.credit), 0) AS completed_credit, ROUND(AVG(g.grade_point), 2) AS avg_grade_point FROM edu_student s LEFT JOIN edu_course_selection cs ON cs.student_id = s.id AND cs.selection_status = 'selected' LEFT JOIN edu_grade g ON g.selection_id = cs.id AND g.grade_status = 'submitted' AND g.score >= 60 LEFT JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON c.id = tc.course_id WHERE s.id = #{studentId} GROUP BY s.id, s.student_no, s.student_name

SELECT 'studentCount' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM edu_student UNION ALL SELECT 'teacherCount', COUNT(*) FROM edu_teacher UNION ALL SELECT 'courseCount', COUNT(*) FROM edu_course UNION ALL SELECT 'selectionCount', COUNT(*) FROM edu_course_selection WHERE selection_status = 'selected'
